parameters.query: SELECT t.id, t.code, t.name, t.status, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id) AS is_owner, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(t.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS end_date, TIME_FORMAT(t.fixtures_day_start, '%H:%i') AS day_start, TIME_FORMAT(t.fixtures_day_end, '%H:%i') AS day_end, DATE_FORMAT(t.fixtures_published_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS published_at, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', d.id, 'name', d.name, 'sort_order', d.sort_order, 'format', d.format, 'group_count', d.group_count,   'qualify_per_group', d.qualify_per_group, 'match_rules', d.match_rules, 'fixture_start', DATE_FORMAT(d.fixture_start, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'),   'fixture_pitches', d.fixture_pitches, 'fixture_gap_minutes', d.fixture_gap_minutes, 'fixture_draw', d.fixture_draw))  FROM tournament_divisions d WHERE d.tournament_id = t.id) AS divisions, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('entry_id', e.id, 'division_id', e.division_id, 'group_no', e.group_no, 'seed', e.seed,   'team_code', tm.code, 'team_name', tm.name, 'team_short', tm.short_name, 'logo_key', tm.logo_key))  FROM tournament_entries e JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = e.team_id WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED') AS teams, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', m.id, 'division_id', m.division_id, 'match_no', m.match_no, 'stage', m.stage, 'group_no', m.group_no,   'round_no', m.round_no, 'label', m.label, 'home_entry_id', m.home_entry_id, 'away_entry_id', m.away_entry_id, 'home_ref', m.home_ref,   'away_ref', m.away_ref, 'pitch', m.pitch, 'scheduled_at', DATE_FORMAT(m.scheduled_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), 'status', m.status,   'home_score', m.home_score, 'away_score', m.away_score)) FROM tournament_matches m WHERE m.tournament_id = t.id) AS matches, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(e.id) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED' AND (  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tournament_entry_players ep WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id AND ep.user_id = viewer.id) OR   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members mm WHERE mm.team_id = e.team_id AND mm.user_id = viewer.id AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.role IN ('COACH', 'CAPTAIN', 'VICE_CAPTAIN')))) AS my_entries FROM tournaments t LEFT JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 WHERE t.code = $2 AND t.status <> 'DRAFT'
